name: Custom Cute ~Ore to Kanojo no Ikusei Battle!~
original_name: カスタムcute ～俺と彼女の育成バトル！～
source:
This is the first game by Momoiro Pocket. Takuma leads a lonely school life and craves to fall in love. There are a few girls who provide him with moral support, but they’re all not his type. Desperate to break free from the monotonous days, he decided to change them to his ideal. However, he will have to overcome their own ideals first!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/06/23/june-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
